Create ONE horizontal row of FOUR complete full-length adult DeepSeek figures for a transparent production sprite sheet. Reference 1 defines the exact outfit and identity to preserve. Reference 2 defines ADULT body proportions only; do not copy reference 2's maid dress. Same DeepSeek mature face, vivid cobalt/cyan long wavy hair, whale ear ornaments, small adult head, approx 7.5-8 head lengths tall. Photorealistic 3D digital adult woman, detailed lifelike skin, hair and cloth. Exact navy/lightblue halter swimdress, white piping, whale pendant, navy slippers from reference 1.
FORMAT 4 columns x 1 row. FOUR HEAD-TO-SHOE full bodies only, wide landscape. True RGBA fully transparent background. Each full silhouette including feet is isolated, wide empty gutters, same camera distance and same scale in all four. Feet share a horizontal baseline. Keep slim natural adult stature, long thighs and shins. NO chibi, doll head, short squat legs, bust crop, contact sheet of torsos. All stand straight with natural knees; only arms change. No floor, backdrop, shadows, text or grid. Every finger connects to the hand, wrist and arm. Prop contact drawn into original art. Four poses LEFT TO RIGHT: 1) High-five preparation: her RIGHT hand (viewer LEFT) rises to shoulder height, relaxed open palm. 2) High-five ready: the same connected arm, open palm facing viewer beside her temple, NOT above head; five natural fingers. 3) High-five contact: the same palm gently presses forward toward viewer at shoulder/temple level; a small happy smile; natural elbow and wrist, no separate floating arm. 4) High-five recoil: hand withdraws slightly back beside shoulder, open relaxed fingers, pleased smile. Left arm rests by side throughout.
